"""核对第64轮实际起点并冻结已有末周期空间的离线诊断范围。"""
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT/'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def read(name):
    return json.loads((DATA/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

def save(name, value):
    with (DATA/name).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as target:
        json.dump(value,target,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        target.write('\n')

assert not (DATA/'v67-plan.json').exists() and not (DATA/'v67-baseline-check.json').exists()
state=read('v66-accepted-state.json')
parent=read('ipm-v66-identity.json')
assert state['passed'] and state['selected_numerical_source']==66
files={name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in state['files']}
libraries={name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in state['libraries']}
assert len(files)==95 and files==state['files']==parent['files']
assert len(libraries)==17 and libraries==state['libraries']==parent['libraries']
assert sha(ROOT/'build/release/solver.exe')==state['solver_sha256']==parent['solver_sha256']
assert sha(ROOT/'.tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe')==parent['solver_sha256']
assert sha(DATA/'ipm-v66-source.zip')==parent['source_zip_sha256']
assert read('v66-verification.json')['passed'] and read('v66-full-assessment.json')['retain_candidate']
assert read('v66-document-check-final.json')['passed']
baseline={
 'created_at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'passed':True,
 'previous_goal_turn':'progress',
 'progress_evidence':'v66实现矩形CHOLMOD并完成500条独立核验，90/91覆盖无损、完整旧新成本下降，已保留实际95来源及18项回归；目标仍未达。',
 'baseline_identity_file':'v66-accepted-state.json','baseline_identity_sha256':sha(DATA/'v66-accepted-state.json'),
 'files':files,'libraries':libraries,'solver_sha256':state['solver_sha256'],
 'parent_identity_sha256':sha(DATA/'ipm-v66-identity.json'),
 'parent_source_zip_sha256':parent['source_zip_sha256'],
 'previous_verification_sha256':sha(DATA/'v66-verification.json'),
 'solver_runs':0,'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__)
}
save('v67-baseline-check.json',baseline)
old=read('v66-plan.json')
models=[]
for name in ('greenbea','forplan','greenbeb'):
    path=ROOT/'.deps/netlib'/(name+'.mps')
    models.append({'name':name,'input':str(path),'sha256':sha(path),'backends':['normal_cholmod_aat']})
expected=copy.deepcopy(old['expected_report_options'])
expected['ipm']['linear_solver']='normal_cholmod_aat'
expected['ipm']['linear_accuracy']='homogeneous_repair'
refs=[
 {'url':'https://arxiv.org/html/2101.11416v1','scope':'已读Krylov-Simplex摘要、固定空间无穷范数LP及相关范数边界；只借鉴离线可行性检验，不声称实现作者完整算法。'},
 {'url':'https://petsc.org/release/src/ksp/ksp/impls/gmres/fgmres/fgmres.c.html','scope':'已读实际PREVEC保存、三角系数求解、组合及重启后真实残差重算；当前release页面不是本项目锁定依赖。'},

p={

 'capture_policy':'只在普通齐次常数factor.solve作用域内、三次既定Krylov重启最终耗尽时提交首事件。保存最后周期base、实际预条件Z、最终coeff/candidate/已有residual、实际G/H/RHS及原global/可选block门槛；不按模型名或预知步数触发，不新增在线算子或求解。',
 'evaluation':'固定18条串行轮转，12个frozen→off及off→on完整非预算对子只排timings，保留版本。非法退出、计数、状态先拒绝；预算分叉不视为兼容。只有全部相同且捕获完整无误才解释分析。',
 'offline_analysis':{
   'space':'x=base+Z*a；中心化使用精确base+Z*a0，不以已舍入candidate替换基点。',

   'negative_conclusion':'未得到独立可行见证只能说未找到；无可靠不可行证书不得宣布原空间无解。',

 'limits':[

   '预算、中断、退化等其他退出不冒充最终耗尽；缓存或metadata超限显式记错，控制输入允许0事件。',

   '原K0为保存double G/H构成的确切矩阵，不以精确s/z或另一个正则矩阵替代。',

 'source_references':refs,
 'local_references':[{'file':name,'sha256':sha(ROOT/name)} for name in (
   '.deps/highs-source/highs/ipm/ipx/kkt_solver_basis.cc','.deps/highs-source/highs/ipm/ipx/conjugate_residuals.cc')]

save('v67-plan.json',p)
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'plan_sha256':sha(DATA/'v67-plan.json'),
